EmailTemplate.subject: How AdventHealth & Banner Health built a cutting edge financial experience
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi,
On July 23rd, we’re partnering with Becker’s to host a very special panel discussion <[[https://go.beckershospitalreview.com/how-adventhealth-banner-health-built-a-modern-financial-experience-that-innovated-at-every-stage-in-the-patient-journey?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>with AdventHealth and Banner Health on how to drive collections, even during a pandemic, by building a modern financial experience that empowers patients to pay at every stage in their journey.
In this webinar, Tim Reiner, SVP of Revenue Cycle at AdventHealth and Brad Tinnermon, VP of Enterprise Revenue Cycle at Banner Health will share with you the planning and execution for constructing a high performing, end-to-end, patient financial engagement engine.
Here's what you will learn:
- How to create a digital financial journey that begins pre-visit and helps to create a seamless experience between your pre-service and post-service revenue cycle departments. - How to achieve organizational buy-in from key stakeholders and staff when building your end-to-end patient engagement engine. - How to leverage estimates to improve collectability and meet key organizational objectives. - How to power affordability by automatically presenting the patient with tailored financial options like payment plans, charity, and patient financing
Join us and register today! <[[https://go.beckershospitalreview.com/how-adventhealth-banner-health-built-a-modern-financial-experience-that-innovated-at-every-stage-in-the-patient-journey?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
How AdventHealth & Banner Health built a modern financial experience that innovated at every stage in the patient journey
Date and Time
Thursday, July 23rd, 2020 | 11:00 am - 12:00 pm CT
Kind Regards,
